commit 011b565f0f8d2ae2272e93ab38d8b7dd21b978c6
Author: VladUZH <25680204+VladUZH@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Fri Sep 25 23:32:25 2026 +0200

    fix(savers): exact caveman replay above a size floor; headroom opt-in
    
    Sampling was off by up to 40% against full replays (rare, spiky savings).
    caveman is now replayed in full above 500 tokens (0% error above the floor,
    ~5% conservative overall); headroom keeps a size-stratified sample with its
    measured error stated, and is no longer offered by the default install.
